representation: 37 baseline-relative Libre readings at 5-minute spacing, 0–180 minutes; baseline mean at -10/-5 min. These are published interpolated observations, not independent native samples.
distance: Shape is curve divided by its RMS. Mixture combines shape and raw-amplitude squared differences scaled by median earlier personal curve RMS. Constrained dynamic time warping up to 0/15/30 minutes.
selection: Earlier rolling windows only; equal dose-band hit rate then MAE with inverse repeat weights. All matched examples are earlier meals of the same person, including initial anchors.
limitation: Copying/averaging historical labels cannot extrapolate past their range; this tests representation, not the full goal by itself.
